architecture-review.json.review: No new project reference, cycle, runtime partial, store interface or reservation index. The cohesive admission owner composes existing exact-run store and per-run lease, with a mandatory business-parent validator. Metadata remains one wire owner for its explicit interactive and inherited variants; existing member-count informational finding changed from10 to12, not a new finding. Runtime dispatch and canonical Process semantics remain outside admission.
